description:
It's time to get your kid on a stylish ride that's the perfect combination of safety, functionality and pure riding fun. Enter the Mongoose Force 4.0 Folding Scooter - the largest model in the Force series - a convenient morning ride that doubles as an exciting weekend get-around.
Folds up for compact storage and transport with easy folding design, perfect for storing in a school locker or under a bus seat
Full-coverage MaxGrip™ on the alloy deck and steel brake combine with 142 mm wheels and durable ABEC-7 bearings to provide smooth non-slip riding
Tool-free height adjustment has three different lock-in points to fit a wide range of riders
Heavy-duty steel frame supports children 8+ up to 220 lbs.
Premium, durable bike-style grips and a bike-style kickstand help protect the handlebar and frame from possible damage
